notes.title: The First Announcement
notes.content:
The first available version of “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” launched on May 27, 2023, and that's just the beginning. I am working hard on the subsequent content. The full content of “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]”, will contain two new game modes.

I know nothing about code. But I will hire good programmers. In order to keep users from being plagued by a bunch of bugs while using it, I made “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” to run smoothly on a low configuration computer. I also have to stick to the humble graphics effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105065/6dcf134a6e284a4f2716f66e4f018694b30d3dc6.jpg[/img]

I will work a few jobs to ensure that “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” has the funds to continue developing until “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” is ready to show its full form.

I want users to use “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” as a tool of practicing English words, rather than a game. For all those who do not know English at all or have very weak English skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105065/67cb89d6f0f0a5c9aa8e495e17664a682b60f184.jpg[/img]

Although “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” has characters, stories, battles, and life. The stories in “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” will reflect heavy reality and also tell stories about the growth of the characters.

“[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” hopes to enable users with zero or weak English skills to learn 8,000 words and then have the ability to read ordinary English articles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105065/a67e4b2a5682b50dabacfe4874457b2760e02b50.jpg[/img]

The first thesaurus (8000 words) has been prepared. I have a plan to update multi-language support and gamepad support in the next version. After that, I will update the content about this thesaurus which will be included in the new game mode, so please be patient and wait.

The achievement system is not available for now. It will be conceived after the next game mode is finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44105065/f1bf2ef961d1e0beffe270624a11fb647ee1355d.jpg[/img]

Thank you very much for your interest in “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” at all times. “[b]DEMONIAC WORDS[/b]” will be developed so that users can have more useful content.
